claims.claim: CTX310 Phase 1a showed durable one-year ANGPTL3, triglyceride and LDL reductions after a single infusion, with highest-dose mean reductions of 79%, 48% and 53% respectively, while Phase 1b is ongoing.

risks.risk: Phase 1a involved only 15 participants and early efficacy/safety cannot establish registrational success.

unknowns.unknown: Phase 1b efficacy, safety and regulatory path remain unresolved.

claims.claim: By Q2 2026 CRISPR Therapeutics had initiated Phase 1 trials for CTX340 and CTX460 and reported continued CASGEVY momentum, while maintaining multiple second-half pipeline milestones.

risks.risk: Broad clinical pipeline increases trial, regulatory and capital-allocation execution burden.

unknowns.unknown: Commercial CASGEVY economics and pipeline cash-burn durability require full financial underwriting.
